settings.custom_liquid: <script>(() => { const page = document.querySelector('.msc-learn-page[data-msc-registry-id=\"MSC-HUB-BASICS\"]'); const card = page ? page.querySelector('.msc-learn-guide-card[data-msc-guide-id=\"MSC-GUIDE-001\"]') : null; if (!card || card.querySelector('.msc-learn-guide-live-link')) return; card.removeAttribute('aria-disabled'); card.classList.add('is-live-guide'); const note = card.querySelector('.msc-learn-preview-note'); if (note) note.remove(); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = '/pages/learn-bitcoin-basics?view=msc-learn-guide'; link.className = 'msc-button msc-learn-guide-live-link'; link.textContent = 'Read guide'; link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Read What Is Bitcoin?'); card.appendChild(link); })();</script>
